tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, development builds included, so there is no dev-only exemption. This is reinforced by the recorded decision to enforce HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception for any service.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It states that TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no dev-only exemption.

The file also notes the later decision to enforce HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception for any service. That decision is about transport rather than certificate verification, so the file describes it only as reinforcing the first.

It leaves out the earlier plan to turn verification off in dev builds, since that was retired.

My first attempt to write the file via `cat` failed with a parser error. I wrote it with the Write tool instead. I didn't re-read it afterward, and I didn't commit anything.
